def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    initial_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    fill_ratio = 1.0 - (rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8))
    base_score = np.exp(fill_ratio) - (rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8))
    is_empty = (bins[valid] == initial_cap)
    bonus = np.where(is_empty, 0.5, 0.0)
    scores[valid] = base_score + bonus
    return scores

    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):

    initial_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    normalized_rem = rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8)
    base_score = -(normalized_rem ** 2) + 2.0 * (1.0 - normalized_rem)

    scores[valid] = base_score + bonus
    return scores

    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    scores[fit] = 1.0 / (1.0 + rem[fit]) + 0.1 * (bins[fit] / max_cap)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full(bins.shape, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    if max_cap == 0:
        max_cap = 1.0
    fit_score = np.exp(-rem[valid])
    capacity_bias = bins[valid] / max_cap
    scores[valid] = fit_score + 0.1 * capacity_bias
    return scores
